entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is ridiculous.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?

I don't have it handy! Just look up my name, Mark Peterson. You guys sent them to me months ago and they've been nothing but trouble. I want a refund, and I want it now or I'm blasting your company all over the internet.

I understand your frustration, Mr. Peterson. I can certainly try looking you up by name. To make sure I can help you properly, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is they're torture devices! They've given me terrible blisters on every long ride. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, tried different socks, everything. They just don't fit right and they're junk. I'm done with them.

Okay, thank you for clarifying. Dealing with blisters is definitely not what we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your account... One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes, delivered about 80 days ago. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
You better check fast. 80 days, 90 days, I don't care. The product is defective. If you don't give me my money back, I want to speak to your manager right now.
That won't be necessary, Mr. Peterson. I've just reviewed our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
So you're actually going to give me a full refund?

Yes, of course. We stand by our products and I'm sorry these didn't work out for you. I am generating a pre-paid return shipping label and I'll email it to you right now. Just place the shoes, along with the cleats, back in the original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be issued.
Huh. Okay. Well, fine. That's what I expected in the first place. Send the email.
I've just sent it. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure that refund comes through quickly.
We will process it as soon as the return is checked in at our warehouse. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
